title: 변환형 함수 1 ( Oracle )  - TO_CHAR, TO_NUMBER, TO_DATE
markdown: > > > > > 목차 > > - [문자 변환: TO_CHAR()](#246eda9b0fe18163b3b8c90fa5aa04a1) > - [숫자 변환: TO_NUMBER()](#249eda9b0fe180eb89eef7dd800aac7b) > - [숫자 변환: TO_DATE()](#249eda9b0fe1809b9d53f9db5d5caceb) ### 문자 변환: TO_CHAR() ```sql # Oracle # TO_CHAR(numeric_expr | date [, format]) SELECT to_char(10), # 결과: '10' to_char(sysdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), # 결과: '2025-08-08' to_char(sysdate, 'YYYY/MM/DD'), # 결과: '2025/08/08' to_char(sysdate, 'YYYY'), # 결과: '2025' to_char(sysdate, 'MM'), # 결과: '08' to_char(sysdate, 'DD'), # 결과: '08' FROM dual; ``` ### 숫자 변환: TO_NUMBER() ```sql # Oracle # TO_NUMBER(char_expr) SELECT to_number('11') # 결과: 11 FROM dual; ``` ### 숫자 변환: TO_DATE() ```sql # Oracle # TO_DATE(char_expr [, format]) SELECT to_date('2025.08.08', 'YYYY.MM.DD') # 결과: 2025-08-08 00:00:00.000 FROM dual; ``` ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/99497b73108215436bc42461f5c43d0cf09ba224/posts/246eda9b-0fe1-80e5-95cf-fc179155eef4/046aca63a0f6540c.webp)
